title: Route outbound traffic through the egress gateway
body:
# Route outbound traffic through the egress gateway

## Context
Services in the Marlin estate call external endpoints, and auditing those calls needs a single choke point.

## Decision
All outbound traffic from services leaves through the egress gateway. No service opens a direct connection to an external endpoint.

## Consequences
Every external call is logged in one place. The gateway becomes a dependency of every service that calls out.
